inputs.question: What is CVE-2024-41713, and are attackers using it?

outputs.answer: A path traversal flaw in the NuPoint Unified Messaging component of Mitel MiCollab, up to and including 9.8.1.201 (9.8 SP1 FP2). An attacker who isn't logged in can view, corrupt or delete users' data and system configuration. CVSS 9.1 Critical. Yes, attackers use it: it has been in CISA KEV since 2025-01-07, ransomware use is Known, and it can be chained with CVE-2024-55550. The fix is in Mitel advisory MISA-2024-0029.

metadata.tests: Direct lookup by CVE number, and reporting exploitation

inputs.question: Tell me about CVE-2026-20362. How serious is it?

outputs.answer: A server-side request forgery (SSRF) flaw in the web management interface of Cisco Finesse. An unauthenticated remote attacker can send crafted HTTP requests and obtain limited sensitive information. CVSS 7.2 High. It is not in CISA KEV, and its exploit forecast (EPSS) is about 0.5%. Cisco lists 28 affected Finesse builds, from 12.6(1) to 15.0(1)SU2. Advisory: cisco-sa-finesse-ssrf-mmSuyugS.

metadata.tests: Direct lookup of a brand-new CVE that NVD hasn't analyzed yet

inputs.question: What does CVE-2025-64328 affect, and is it being exploited?

outputs.answer: FreePBX Endpoint Manager: a command injection in the filestore module of the administrative interface, after login, in versions 17.0.2.36 and later before 17.0.3. CVSS 7.2 High. Yes, it is being exploited: it has been in CISA KEV since 2026-02-03 (ransomware use Unknown), and its exploit forecast is about 85%.

metadata.tests: Direct lookup, with version range and exploitation status

inputs.question: Explain CVE-2022-29499.

outputs.answer: A remote code execution flaw in the Service Appliance component (SA 100, SA 400 and Virtual SA) of Mitel MiVoice Connect through 19.2 SP3, caused by incorrect data validation. CVSS 9.8 Critical. It has been in CISA KEV since 2022-06-27, and ransomware use is Known.

metadata.tests: Direct lookup of an older, ransomware-linked CVE

inputs.question: Tell me about CVE-2024-4196. Is it being exploited?

outputs.answer: An improper input validation flaw in the Web Control component of Avaya IP Office: a specially crafted web request can lead to remote command or code execution. It affects all versions before 11.1.3.1, so the fix is 11.1.3.1 or later. CVSS 9.8 Critical. It is not in CISA KEV, so there is no confirmed exploitation, and its exploit forecast (EPSS) is low, about 0.6%.

metadata.tests: Direct lookup for an Avaya product, and 'not in KEV' stated without overstating it

inputs.question: Is CVE-2022-26143 being exploited, and which Mitel products does it affect?

outputs.answer: Yes. It is the TP-240 (tp240dvr) flaw in Mitel MiCollab before 9.4 SP1 FP1 and MiVoice Business Express through 8.1. Remote attackers can obtain sensitive information and cause a denial of service (performance degradation and excessive outbound traffic); it was exploited in the wild in February and March 2022 for the TP240PhoneHome DDoS attack. CVSS 9.8 Critical. In CISA KEV since 2022-03-25, ransomware use Unknown, exploit forecast about 87%.

metadata.tests: Direct lookup of a CVE that spans two Mitel products

inputs.question: Could someone near a Mitel desk phone attack it over Bluetooth?

inputs.question: Can a FreePBX user who only has User Control Panel access run commands on the server?

outputs.answer: Yes: CVE-2026-54674 (8.8 High). In FreePBX versions before 16.0.39 and 17.0.7, users who log in to the User Control Panel (UCP) can run arbitrary commands on the PBX as the web server user. That matters because UCP accounts are usually given to less-trusted users than admin accounts.

inputs.question: Could other websites be used to brute-force logins on our Verint Impact 360 sign-in page?

outputs.answer: Yes, in Verint Impact 360 15.1. CVE-2019-12784 (8.8 High): the login form at wfo/control/signin accepts submissions from external websites (cross-site request forgery). CVE-2019-12783 (6.1 Medium): its rd parameter accepts any URL to redirect to after login. Together, attackers can "crowdsource" brute-force login attempts through visitors' browsers, without sending traffic from their own machines. Neither is in CISA KEV.

metadata.tests: A plain-language attack story matched to two chained CVEs
